headline: Forest’s chance volume earns only a point at Ipswich

sentences.text: Nottingham Forest’s 17 shots and 2.29 xG dwarfed Ipswich Town’s 7 shots and 0.46 xG, yet the sides shared a 1–1 draw in the Premier League.

Forest also led 5–0 on corners and created 2 big chances to Ipswich’s 1, but neither team scored after the break; the near-even 49.4%–50.6% possession split offers little explanation for the gap in threat.
